<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/liveness/page.json`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **1** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **142** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json c980d114d3bdde4b2b639650cb762687a8da41fa` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `a17092cff26b397569bbc778b036537d3f2b205f` — the merge of head `4196cb921ec6cd79bc20bd05558187ffcd83bbe7` into base `c980d114d3bdde4b2b639650cb762687a8da41fa`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin a17092cff26b397569bbc778b036537d3f2b205f && git checkout a17092cff26b397569bbc778b036537d3f2b205f
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin c980d114d3bdde4b2b639650cb762687a8da41fa 4196cb921ec6cd79bc20bd05558187ffcd83bbe7 && git checkout -B drift-repro c980d114d3bdde4b2b639650cb762687a8da41fa && git merge --no-ff 4196cb921ec6cd79bc20bd05558187ffcd83bbe7

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json c980d114d3bdde4b2b639650cb762687a8da41fa
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs c980d114d3bdde4b2b639650cb762687a8da41fa` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

**Verdict: ACCEPT.** Not governed (`check-governed-merges --pr 23589`). 3 files, +700 / −2,070, 2,770 changed lines, under the 3,000-line line. Prose and ledger-note work with `Clause-②: no`, so no contract review is owed; this record is the review.

2. **Scope against the claim.** Item 1 (group C) for the first half of `component.zod.ts` (base lines 1–7227). The claim set the split rule before any code: over 3,000 changed lines, PRs under the line each, the last one carrying `Fixes`. The union is 7,395 lines, and `component.zod.ts` alone is 5,675. So the split runs by file range rather than strictly by item. Accepted.
3. **Seat readings, taken on this head and not copied from the report.**
   - **Code is unchanged.** I compared the parser-accurate token stream of `component.zod.ts` (TypeScript AST leaves, JSDoc excluded) at merge base `fa6a6085c0` with this head. Both have 22,324 tokens, with 0 differences.

   - **Evidence resolves.** I sampled 12 of the 186 direct `objectui @SHA FILE#SYMBOL` references in the note, evenly spaced, and resolved each at its own objectui SHA: the file exists there and the symbol occurs in it. 12 of 12 resolved. The sample includes the three historical trees `db11afd496`, `2e818d0b51` and `31971ff1e2`.
   - **Merge.** `git merge-tree` against `origin/main` `744b73f53f` is clean.
   - **Prose.** I read a slice of the diff: each record keeps its claim about the renderer and points to `liveness/page.json`, row `regions`. Change markers such as "since objectui `ce991bd70`" stay.
4. **Accepted deviations.**
   - The full derived battery ran on the union and on part 3's head, not on this part alone (a declared narrowing). CI runs the full set here.
   - `check:platform-checklist` is red on the base: 7 ABSENT SYMBOL anchors into `packages/metadata-protocol` and `service-storage`, which this PR does not touch.
5. **Out-of-scope dispositions.** None from this part. Part 3 (#23591) carries the census remainder and the open questions.
6. **Landing clauses.**
   - (a) Every check is green or skipped by design: read at landing, after the skip roster answers OK.
   - (b) `mergeable_state` is clean at enqueue: read at landing.

### ① Derived judgments

Post-hoc review of PR #23589 (part 1 of 3 of PR-2 for card #23434), judged as if it were still waiting to enter the queue. Inputs: the card body and every comment (rulings `6165388570` and `6181034096`; dev reports `6168538808`, `6170782619`, `6183204136`, `6183710619`), the PR body and file list, the net diff `fa6a6085c0..4196cb921e` (3 files, +700 / -2,070), and the 43 check-runs on the head. Every reading below is a `git show` / `git diff` of fetched refs in this repo, or a `git show` / `git grep` of the sibling objectui clone at the cited SHA; nothing was built, run or re-run.

**Accept set: unchanged (right).** `packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts` with its comments stripped is byte-identical between `fa6a6085c0` and this head (211,301 characters each side, string literals kept), so no Zod shape, `.describe()` string, strict door, default, refinement, export or type changed. All 2,069 removed and 688 added lines sit inside `/** … */` or `//` comments (a line scan of the diff finds zero non-comment lines in either direction). The `ComponentPropsMap` registrations (around head line 9558 onward) change only their inline comments.

**Published surface that does change, two things, both right:**

1. The JSDoc text of `src/ui/component.zod.ts`, which ships as source (`files[]` in `packages/spec/package.json` at `fa6a6085c0` lists `src/**/*.zod.ts`) and as the docblocks of exported declarations in `dist/*.d.ts`. The change is the deletion of the per-hop re-read chains ("At X, re-read there DATE … byte-identical … held unmoved / MOVED by N") and, in their place, the sentence "read points recorded in `liveness/page.json`, row `regions`" (head lines 622, 693-694, 2949-2950, 5760-5761 are examples). The chains carried line-number bookkeeping, not renderer behaviour; each record's substantive claim stays in the shorter comment: the `object-kanban.limit` four-face record (head 5757-5778), the `action:icon` key-by-key record (3901-3930), the `element:button.icon` resolver history (2946-2990). Counts for this file, base to head: `.objectui-sha` mentions 52 to 24, `objectui SHA` 108 to 63, `File.tsx:NNN` 261 to 126, hop-chain lines 969 to 556; the balance is the second half, which #23590 removes (the two halves' removals sum exactly to the base counts).
2. `packages/spec/liveness/page.json`, `props.regions.note` (`files[]` lists `liveness`): the note grows to 62,138 characters with a 120-entry evidence list in source order, each entry `COMPONENT.member: objectui @SHA FILE#SYMBOL`, headed by the sentence that the list asserts no verdict. The row's `status`, `evidence`, `verifiedAt` and `evidenceScope` are untouched; `check:liveness` path-scans `evidence` and `producer`, not `note`, and `Spec property liveness` is green on this head. The line is byte-identical at the three heads (sha256 of the note starts `bf5b96cec57d` at `4196cb921e`, `3c7f4da05c` and `be8657fa44`), and `main` after the three landings (`56b2612778`) carries that same note, so no part lands a partial list. Every entry is spelled by symbol, none by line number (ruling `6165388570` item 2).

No generated docs page changes (no `content/docs/**` in the file list, and `check:docs` runs inside the green `TypeScript Type Check` job), so the moved paragraphs are not ones `gen:docs` renders.

**Sentences that could now be false: none found.** Checked:

- Every pointer sentence names a row that exists and holds the record: the list runs `[1] page:header` through `[120] PageComponent.visibleWhen`, and the records this half moves (the page and record blocks, the element and action rows, object-grid, object-metric, the first part of object-kanban) are entries [1] to [59].

- The `record:related_list.parentDataSource` docblock (head 1649-1650) now says "PLANNED, not yet read: no renderer reads this key (measured on objectui; recorded in the `liveness/page.json` `_note`)". The `_note` carries it: "PLANNED, not live: measured at objectui @f0532d8a, the block reads its parent from the record context only (… RecordRelatedListBody reads useRecordContext()) and nothing reads the key". True, and entry [10] points back to the `_note`.

**Landing check (post-hoc):** the squash `2372e0a7b7` has the same `git patch-id --stable` as `fa6a6085c0..4196cb921e` once `page.json` is excluded; its parent `5afa1e05a7` (part 2) had already landed the identical `page.json` line, which is why the squash shows 2 files. Nothing landed that this review did not read.

### ② Semver level

`.changeset/23434-component-read-points-part-1.md` declares `'@objectstack/spec': patch` and carries `Clause-②: no`; the PR body's third line is `Clause-②: no`. Both are right. The packed tarball changes (`src/**/*.zod.ts` and `liveness` are both in `files[]`), so a changeset is owed and `skip-changeset` would be wrong; no accept set widens or narrows, so `no` with no arm is the correct declaration and `patch` is its level (`yes` would demand at least `minor`; a `(narrowing)` arm would be breaking, and nothing narrows). The changeset body says what the spec source stops carrying, as ruling `6165388570` item 5 asks, and names no model, no tracker-shaped runtime string. `Check Changeset` is green on the head.
